note: Read by scripts/select_qat_epoch.py and scripts/select_clip.py through src/quant/qat_select.py (lane 6, L-AM4 + L-AM1q). Must agree with configs/quant.py; src/quant/qat_select.py refuses a disagreement.

qat_epoch.source: AM-4; AM-4a item 2; AM-19 item 3(a); DL-09; DL-38
qat_epoch.value: dataset_level.all_class_miou of the epoch's converted QNNPACK TorchScript artifact, scored by scripts/evaluate_model.py
qat_epoch.excluded: an epoch whose state is non-finite: excluded: non-finite state (AM-19 item 3(a))

qat_clip.rejected: a run with nonfinite_since_step set or any epoch_end state_finite false (AM-21 item 3); both rejected: no winner

band.rule: tie iff |Fraction(a) - Fraction(b)| <= Fraction(1, 1000) on the stored float64 values
